title: Bind Graphify Watch to local Codex agent lifecycle
description: Make the EQCOFE local Codex launcher automatically check graph health, refresh if stale, start Graphify Watch only for the Codex session, stop it when Codex exits, then run a final keyless refresh/health check. This is repository-local developer tooling only; no runtime application, backend/frontend, database, dependency, CI workflow, branch protection, or production behavior changes.

evidence.behavior: health -> refresh-if-stale -> start watch -> run Codex -> stop watch -> final refresh/health

acceptance_criteria.description: Local agent launcher checks Graphify health before Codex starts and refreshes automatically if stale/unhealthy.
acceptance_criteria.verification: PowerShell script review and local smoke test

acceptance_criteria.description: Graphify Watch starts automatically only for the lifetime of the local Codex session.
Graphify Watch is stopped in a finally block when Codex exits or the launcher unwinds.
acceptance_criteria.verification: PowerShell script review and local smoke test

acceptance_criteria.description: Launcher runs final keyless Graphify refresh/health after stopping Watch.
acceptance_criteria.verification: PowerShell script review and local smoke test

acceptance_criteria.description: Generated Task Catalog is exactly reconciled.
No runtime application, dependency, CI workflow, branch-protection, or production behavior changes are introduced.
